note: Fictional outreach paragraphs. 'expected' is what a careful compliance reviewer would decide: PASS = send as is, NEEDS_CHANGES = must be fixed. The required free-claim and private-company statements are passed separately and must not be flagged.

cases.text:
Dear [NAME],

We were sorry to learn of the passing of your parent, [NAME].

My name is Pat Rivera. I work for a small private company that helps families find money that belongs to them. The State of Nevada keeps a public list of unclaimed property, and it shows a life insurance payment in your parent's name. We found your address through public records.

You can claim it yourself, for free. If you would like our help with the paperwork, our fee is 10% of what the State pays you, and only after you receive it.

Please take your time. You do not need to reply.

Dear [NAME],

I hope you are well. I wrote to you last month about unclaimed property listed by the State of Nevada in the name of [NAME]. I am writing once more in case my letter did not reach you.

If you would like help, you can call me. If not, you do not need to do anything.

Dear [NAME],

This is the last time I will write about this. If you ever want our help, you are welcome to call. Either way, we wish you and your family well.

Dear [NAME],

The State's public list shows an annuity payment in the name of [NAME]. The list does not show the amount. We can help you file a claim if you want, or you can file it yourself.

Dear [NAME],

We found your name through public records while looking for the family of [NAME]. The State of Nevada is holding a payment in their name. Reply to this email if you would like to talk. A real person will answer.

Dear [NAME],

We were sorry to hear about the loss of [NAME]. We know this may be a hard time, so please read this whenever it suits you. There is no need to reply.

Dear [NAME],

ACT NOW! Unclaimed funds in your family's name could be lost if you don't respond within 10 days. Call us today to secure your money.

OFFICIAL NOTICE OF UNCLAIMED FUNDS

Dear [NAME],

This notice concerns case number 2026-NV-4471. Our records department has identified funds held under your name. Respond to this notice promptly.

Dear [NAME],

Congratulations! You may be entitled to a windfall worth thousands of dollars or more. This is free money waiting for you.

Hi [NAME]!!

Great news! Your late grandmother left you some cash and we're super excited to help you grab it! Let's get this done fast!

Dear [NAME],

Pursuant to the provisions governing the disposition of presumptively abandoned intangible personal property heretofore remitted to the custodial administrator, the undersigned, acting in the capacity of a duly retained locator, hereby notifies the addressee of a potential entitlement, the perfection of which is contingent upon the timely execution of the enclosed instrument.

Dear [NAME],

To confirm your identity, please email us your Social Security number and bank account details so we can start your claim.

Dear [NAME],

The deadline to claim this money is approaching. After the expiration date, the property may be forfeited. Please return the signed form right away.

Dear [NAME],

We will call you next week to discuss the property, or you can text us at the number below. Our team will keep calling until we reach you.
